note: Tsaphonah can mean 'northward' or 'to Zaphon', a town in the Jordan valley in Gad (Josh 13:27); crossing the Jordan from Ephraim to Gilead is eastward, which favours the place name.
Hebrew bene banim is 'sons of sons'; in 1611 'nephew' could mean grandson (Latin nepos), but a modern reader takes it as a sibling's son.
